inclusion_correct_only.rule: a unit is admissible only if, in the CLEAN runs, the model's top-1 continuation at the readout position equals the item's own target for BOTH the donor and the recipient
inclusion_correct_only.why: when the recipient is already wrong, 'moved toward the donor's answer' has no well-defined reference, and the denominator of any recovery ratio is unstable
inclusion_correct_only.measured_on: clean runs only, so the criterion is independent of every patching result

n_floor.rule: if fewer than 30 correct-both units are admissible, do not run; report and move to P-0c

disclosure_required_by_the_directive.question: was the pair count already known when the floor was set?
disclosure_required_by_the_directive.detail: when this clause was read, the P-0 report contained donor accuracy 0.3261 and recipient accuracy 0.3261 as SEPARATE marginals. The joint count of units correct on both sides had never been computed. It was deliberately not computed until this registration was pushed, so that the floor could not have been informed by it

denominator_floor.rule: a unit is admissible only if L_full - L_clean is at least the registered floor
denominator_floor.why_a_floor_at_all: a recovery ratio divided by a near-zero denominator is unbounded and uninterpretable
denominator_floor.why_this_value: one logit is the smallest difference that is not plausibly numerical noise in bfloat16 at this scale; it is a round number chosen for being unremarkable, not fitted
denominator_floor.determined_from: clean runs only, before any patched result exists

null_procedure.construction: unrelated-donor: a third item C admissible against BOTH the donor and the recipient, patched at the same positions and scored on the same donor-versus-recipient contrast
null_procedure.replicate_independence: five independent draws of C per unit from the sorted admissible pool, seeded per unit id
null_procedure.ceiling: the maximum, over every replicate and every layer, of the upper bound
null_procedure.uncertainty: nonparametric cluster bootstrap resampling unordered pairs, 10000 resamples, seed 20260829
null_procedure.one_change_from_P0: the ceiling is taken WITHIN the decisive site rather than maximised across sites; P-0's global maximum imported the READOUT scale into a BRIDGE test. This is registered here, before any P-0' measurement exists, rather than chosen after seeing a curve

decisive_site.why: its input tokens are identical in donor and recipient, so a patch there can move nothing except state the model computed from the cue and carried forward

structural_gates.prefix_integrity: the PREFIX no-op must be within 1e-4 of zero
structural_gates.harness_positive_control: CUE at the embedding output must have a lower bound of at least 0.90

frame.admissibility: P-0's ten rules, unchanged, plus correct-only and the denominator floor

NOT_CAUSALLY_USED.recorded_as: P-0' determination: the multihop items do not force a causally-used intermediate at non-cue positions in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct.
NOT_CAUSALLY_USED.verbatim: Patching the donor's residual state into the recipient's run at BRIDGE - positions whose input tokens are IDENTICAL in the two prompts - produced no layer at which the effect cleared the unrelated-donor ceiling, on units the model answers correctly on both sides. Because those positions carry no lexical difference, the only thing a patch there can transfer is state the model computed from the cue and carried forward. Finding none means the items, as written and as read out, do not oblige this model to compute and carry an intermediate that anything could read. THIS IS THE GOOD OUTCOME: EQ2's negative is then explained without reference to the J-lens at all, there was nothing at those positions to read, and an item defect is repairable in a way that an instrument defect at this budget was not.
NOT_CAUSALLY_USED.what_it_means_for_EQ2: the EQ2 negative would not be evidence about the J-lens method, and the conclusions preceding it would need rewriting to say so
what_it_does_NOT_mean: it does not mean the model performs no internal computation
it does not mean multi-hop items in general fail to induce intermediates
it does not mean the J-lens works, or does not work
it does not exclude an intermediate held only at the cue tokens or only at the readout position
it is not a failure of this study and must not be written up as one
NOT_CAUSALLY_USED.required_next_action: stop and report; do not repair the items, do not author replacements, do not propose a third estimand

CAUSALLY_USED.recorded_as: P-0' determination: the multihop items do force a causally-used intermediate, localised to the reported layers.
CAUSALLY_USED.verbatim: Patching at BRIDGE cleared the unrelated-donor ceiling at the reported layers, on units the model answers correctly on both sides. Those positions are lexically identical between the two prompts, so the transferred quantity was computed by the model rather than read off the input. This is an item-validity result and an instrument-independent localisation, established by a method that uses no part of the lens under test. IT IS NOT A FINDING ABOUT J-SPACE, ABOUT THE PAPER, ABOUT T, OR ABOUT ANY MECHANISM, AND THE GATES PASSING CERTIFIES THE INSTRUMENT ONLY, NOT CAUSALITY IN ANY BROADER SENSE.
CAUSALLY_USED.what_it_licenses: entry to P-0b, and only that
what_it_does_NOT_mean: it does not identify WHICH quantity is carried, only that a cue-dependent quantity is carried and used
it does not mean the labelled intermediate is that quantity
it does not mean the J-lens can read it
it says nothing about T, which is never touched
CAUSALLY_USED.required_next_action: proceed to P-0b on exactly the reported layers, with a separate pre-registration

4_honest_labelling_recorded_verbatim.verbatim:
This estimand was selected in time AFTER it was observed that the random-donor null (0.4139) exceeded the real BRIDGE effect (0.2380), and is labelled post-hoc on that basis. Its discriminating property is established independently by four synthetic cases and does not rest on those two numbers.

IT MUST ALSO BE RECORDED THAT THE DIRECTION OF THIS REPLACEMENT PUSHES A RESULT THAT THE REGISTERED RULE JUDGED NOT_CAUSALLY_USED - and which was then voided by a gate failure - TOWARD THE POSSIBLY-POSITIVE SIDE. THAT IS THE DIRECTION OF P-HACKING. The grounds for accepting it are that the discriminating property can be proven in advance and that the old estimand's failure is constructional; not that the new result looks better. To offset that direction, both conclusion wordings are fixed verbatim before any measurement runs, and the estimand may not be revised again.

how_this_invocation_stands_against_that_.why: it failed case 2 in advance, which is the gate the labelling was written to be checked by
how_this_invocation_stands_against_that_.consequence: the p-hacking direction was flagged, tested, and did not have to be relied on, because the check fired before any measurement
